output.summary: KEP-3570 moved the CPU Manager to stable (implemented, stage stable). It replaces the earlier sig-node KEP 375-cpumanager and was tracked under the new number after an early tracking-number mix-up.
output.rationale: The CPU Manager was consumed by multiple parties and treated as GA, so maintainers wanted to avoid a permanent beta status. Reviewers asked for observability (pinning request and error metrics) before GA, which the KEP added as cpu_manager_pinning_requests_total and cpu_manager_pinning_errors_total. The 1.26 cycle delivered the work, and the status was later set to implemented.

alternatives.why_not: Maintainers wanted to avoid it because the CPU Manager is consumed by multiple parties and treated as GA.
Reviewers asked to update the filename and KEP number to match the new tracking number; the author moved the KEP to 3570 using git mv.

alternatives.option: Mark the KEP implementable for 1.27 and keep it in 1.27 tracking
alternatives.why_not: The maintainer said the enhancement was done in the 1.26 cycle and was labeled by mistake, so it was removed from 1.27 tracking.
